digest.component_or_area: documentation tooling and config schema reference
propositions: A new generator script must create config-reference.md and security.md wholly from schema and deprecation registries, leaving docs/config.md entirely unchanged.
Both generated docs must carry a banner naming 'python scripts/gen_config_reference.py' and be registered in the GENERATED map and docs/README.md table.
A --check drift mode must fail on stale docs and handle CRLF line endings without false positives, tested by pytest under make test.

Topic coverage across both generated docs must include all required headings: precedence, source, lifecycle, restart/redeploy rotation, native refresh, observability exception, subprocess limitations, behavior deltas, and MCP/CLI exposure.
All existing consumers of docs/config.md (content-asserting tests and anchor deep links) must remain intact and passing.
